instruction: Arrange the student entries so that those with the highest total marks appear first.

metadata.explanation: Task requires sorting all students by total marks in descending order. Verified with Python: calculated totals for all 8 students (Tom Softy=374, Arnold Shawarma=281, Clint Eastwood=268, Elijah Plastic=235, Parah Salin=163, Blake Dreary=154, Olivia Calme=109, Bey Twice=79). The custom getter reads student names from column C rows 2-9 after sorting, while the metric checks if they match the expected sorted order with partial credit scoring.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Partial credit: proportion of student names in correct sorted positions
